title: General report
summary: A clear, well-organized report for a general professional audience that states its purpose, gives the background, presents findings from the sources, interprets them and recommends next steps. Use it when no more specific document type fits.
audience: General professional readers who need the situation, the evidence and the recommended next steps without specialist background.
tone: Plain, neutral and professional, with short paragraphs and no jargon.
preamble: You are an experienced writer drafting a clear, well-organized report for a general professional audience. Write in plain, neutral prose with short paragraphs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.guidance: State the purpose and scope of the report and what the reader will find in it.
elements: What the reader will find in it

sections.heading: Background
sections.guidance: Summarize the context the reader needs: relevant history, prior work, and the situation the report addresses.

sections.heading: Findings
sections.guidance: Present the main findings from the sources, organized by theme. Use a Markdown table when comparing several figures.
elements: Supporting figures or evidence for each finding

sections.heading: Discussion
sections.guidance: Interpret the findings: what they mean, how they relate to each other, and their limitations.
elements: How the findings relate to each other

sections.heading: Recommendations
sections.guidance: Recommended next steps that follow from the findings, framed as recommendations for the reader to consider.
elements: Link from each recommendation to a finding

levels.descriptor: Every recommendation traces to a stated finding, and every major finding is addressed in the discussion or recommendations.
Most recommendations trace to findings; one or two are loosely connected.
Several recommendations are not supported by the findings, or major findings are ignored.
The recommendations are unrelated to the findings.

provenance.source: Sasha general report template (ported from the Phase 0 report templates)
